card.name: Casino
card.tagline: Cuban-style salsa, basis of Rueda de Casino.
card.profile: Casino (known since the 1970s as Cuban salsa / salsa cubana) is a partner dance developed in Havana in the early-to-mid 1950s, named after the casinos deportivos dance halls. A circular (rather than slotted) partner dance, it fuses Son Cubano footwork with figures from Cuban mambo, cha-cha-cha, rumba guaguanco and North American jive, traditionally danced contratiempo. Dancers improvise references to Afro-Cuban folklore (Orisha gestures, rumba). It is the basis of Rueda de Casino, a round dance with a caller and frequent partner changes (English Wikipedia).
card.insight: Casino's spontaneous integration of Afro-Cuban dance vocabulary (rumba, Orisha gestures) within a partner dance distinguishes it sharply from the slotted, linear North American salsa styles (English Wikipedia).
